releases.author: Perry661
releases.description:
## 中文

这是一次兼容性与稳定性更新，使 Count Words and Time 更好地适配最新的 Obsidian 插件 API。

### 更新内容

- 升级设置页面，支持 Obsidian 设置搜索
- 加强已保存设置的数据校验与容错能力
- 修复侧边栏打开操作中的异步处理问题
- 更新构建依赖，消除社区插件审核警告
- 最低支持版本调整为 Obsidian 1.13.0

## English

This compatibility and stability update brings Count Words and Time in line with the latest Obsidian plugin APIs.

### What’s changed

- Upgraded the settings page with support for Obsidian settings search
- Improved validation and recovery for saved settings data
- Fixed asynchronous handling when opening the sidebar view
- Updated build dependencies to resolve community plugin review warnings
- Updated the minimum supported Obsidian version to 1.13.0
[main.js](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/30395116/main.js)
